title: Welcome to the New TSG Noticeboard!
short: The new TSG digital noticeboard is now live. Explore the new features and stay updated.
full:
We are excited to announce the launch of the new Technology Students' Gymkhana (TSG) digital noticeboard. This platform is your central hub for campus information, announcements, and events.

Features:
- Real-Time Updates
- Powerful Search
- Personalized Notifications
- Intuitive Categories
- Mobile-Friendly Design

title: Club Registrations Open
short: Registrations for all campus clubs are now open. Join your favorite club today!
full:
Dear Students,

Registrations for all campus clubs are now open for the semester. Visit the clubs section on the noticeboard to learn more about each club and register online.

For queries, contact the respective club coordinators.

title: Upcoming Tech Fest
short: Get ready for the annual Tech Fest! Registrations for events are now open.
full:
The annual Tech Fest is around the corner! Participate in coding, robotics, and design competitions. Check the events section for details and registration links.

Don't miss out on the fun and learning!

title: Hall Activities This Weekend
short: Join us for fun activities in your hall this weekend. All are welcome!
full: This weekend, various fun and engaging activities are planned in all halls. From sports tournaments to movie nights, there is something for everyone. Check your hall's schedule for more details.

title: Academic Circular: Mid-Sem Exams
short: Mid-semester exams will begin from August 10. Check the timetable attached.
full: The mid-semester exams for all courses will commence from August 10. Please find the detailed timetable attached. Ensure you are prepared and reach the exam halls on time.

title: Official Announcement: Campus WiFi Upgrade
short: Campus WiFi will be upgraded on August 5. Expect brief outages.
full: The campus WiFi infrastructure will be upgraded on August 5 to improve speed and reliability. There may be brief outages during the upgrade window. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Sports Meet Registrations
short: Registrations for the annual sports meet are now open. Sign up to participate.
full: The annual sports meet is coming soon! Register for your favorite sports and represent your hall. Details about events and schedules are available in the attached document.

title: Cultural Night Auditions
short: Auditions for Cultural Night performances will be held next week.
full: Showcase your talent at the upcoming Cultural Night! Auditions for dance, music, and drama will be held next week. Check the attached schedule for timings and venues.

title: Tech Society Workshop
short: Attend the Tech Society's workshop on AI and ML this Friday.
full: The Tech Society is organizing a workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning this Friday. All interested students are welcome. Register using the link in the attached document.

title: Blood Donation Camp
short: A blood donation camp will be held on campus on August 7.
full: Join us for the blood donation camp organized in collaboration with the local hospital. Your contribution can save lives. See the attached flyer for more details.
